label: context.reference
text: This is the bound capability contract for the Remote Operator Application at exact World interface world_remote_operator. Installation proves only that the self-contained interface package is present. Project availability requires the real project EE policy to admit world_remote_operator. Task connection requires an authored exact world_remote_operator interface binding plus this artifact binding. Live means the interface has emitted current remote_operator.status evidence from its running private world; installed, available, connected, enabled, or previously paired are separate facts and none may be substituted for current connection evidence. Send remote_operator.request artifacts using exact catalog ids. Pairing, ChatGPT account auth, enrollment, token refresh, client cursors, reconnect timing, segmentation, and acknowledgements remain private interface state; API-key auth is rejected fail-closed. Pairing artifacts expose only the short-lived pairing value needed by the operator and must not be copied into general logs or context. Inbound remote client content becomes a remote_operator.input artifact with exact client, stream, sequence, cursor, and transport evidence. Outbound content is sent through remote_operator.deliver and becomes remote_operator.delivery evidence; a sent request is not proof of delivery until that artifact reports its wire sequence and acknowledgement state. The interface does not expose app-server methods, thread/session ids, provider authority, hidden managers, compatibility fallbacks, or runtime timers. A remote client speaks artifact-native message bodies; any private wire envelopes are transport detail and never Octopus routing ontology.
